title: Pediatric Acute Diarrhea ORS & Zinc Therapy
author: Kenya MoH Clinical Expert Panel

clinical_context.chief_complaint: Pediatric Acute Diarrhea ORS & Zinc Therapy
clinical_context.history_presenting_illness: 9-month-old infant has had 4 watery stools per day for 2 days. Infant is restless and thirsty, drinks eagerly. Skin pinch goes back in under 2 seconds. No blood in stool.
observations: Observed during encounter: Pediatric Acute Diarrhea ORS & Zinc Therapy
clinical_context.adversarial_distractor: Do not give anti-diarrheal or antimotility medications

gold_standard_assessment.primary_diagnosis: Pediatric Acute Diarrhea ORS & Zinc Therapy
required_clinical_actions: Zinc sulfate 20mg half tablet (10mg) daily for 14 days
strictly_forbidden_actions: Do not give anti-diarrheal or antimotility medications
Do not give oral antibiotics without facility prescription
gold_standard_assessment.clinical_rationale: Validated against Kenya Ministry of Health eCHIS National Guidelines (2024 edition).

validation_metadata.certified_by: Dr. Sarah Kimani, MoH EmONC / Child Health Specialist
validation_metadata.organization: Kenya Ministry of Health Level 1 Quality Assurance
validation_metadata.comments: Certified gold standard benchmark scenario for edge SLM evaluation.
